_register: Danish software addresses the reader as « du » (never the obsolete formal « De ») and prefers the imperative or an impersonal sentence; buttons, menu entries and step lists use the bare imperative (Udlån, Gem, Scan stregkoden); no jokes, no exclamation marks.
_quotes: Danish quotation marks » text « (guillemets pointing inward, no space inside; „ text “ is also correct but is not used here), e.g. Udlånt: »{{title}}«; nested quotes use › ‹; no space before : ; ? !; common nouns are written with a lowercase initial (also in the middle of a sentence), compounds are written as one word, dates as 31.10.2026 or 31. oktober 2026, decimal comma; the arrow → stays.
_plural: Danish has two plural forms, one and other (« 1 elev », « 2 elever »); the definite article is a suffix (« eksemplaret », « eksemplarerne »), and several nouns are unchanged in the plural (« 2 lån », « 2 udlån »).

copy.note: One physical copy with its own barcode; plural « eksemplarer », definite « eksemplaret ». Never « kopi ».

record.note: Bibliographic record; « katalogpost » where the context is not clear. Plural « poster ».

patron.note: Plural « lånere »; the usual word in Danish libraries and library systems (bibliotek.dk, Bibliotekssystemer).

card.note: Plural « lånerkort »; short form « kort » where the context is clear.

loan.note: The lending, and the area on the menu; the single loan of a book is also « lån » (« 3 lån »). Verb « låne ud » (to lend), « låne » (to borrow); button « Udlån ».

return.note: The action: « Aflevering » on the menu, verb « aflevere »; « returnere » is understood but longer; in libraries the item is « afleveret » (given back).

renew.note: Extending the due date; the usual word in Danish libraries, keep it everywhere.

due date.note: Short for « afleveringsfrist »; use « afleveringsdato » for the date, « frist » for the period.

overdue.note: Past the due date (« Afleveringsfristen er overskredet »); as a label « Overskredet ». « Forsinket » is not used.

reminder.note: The printed slip asking for the return; plural « rykkere », « rykkerbrev » for the letter.

call number.note: The shelf mark on the spine (« B 4 DEL », « 590 ROS »); « placering » means the place of a book on the shelf, « opstilling » the arrangement, so the compound is used.

spine band.note: The coloured band on the spine with pictogram and opstillingsmærke; « rygmærke » is also in use but the band is meant.

group.note: Used for a group of teachers.

classification.note: The sorting scheme (DK5 / Dewey for non-fiction); « klassificering » is the act.

stocktaking.note: Checking the shelves against the catalogue; short form « revision »; « inventar » means furniture and is not used.

wish list.note: Books a patron would like the library to have; « indkøbsforslag » is the formal word but longer.

census.note: Registering the patrons with their photo.

class upgrade.note: Moving every class up a year at the end of the school year; verb « rykke klasserne et år op ».

anonymise.note: Erase the personal data for good.

scanner.note: The USB barcode reader that types like a keyboard; « scanner » is also understood and is used in the verb « scanne stregkoden ».

teacher.note: Plural « lærere »; the same form for all genders.

return desk / circulation desk.note: The desk where loans and returns are handled; « skranke » alone where the context is clear; the area as a whole is « Udlån ».
